findings.title: foreign invoices are returned to the caller
findings.explanation: GetInvoice returns the invoice after only checking whether the ID exists; it never verifies inv.TenantID against the tenantID claim. An authenticated request for an existing invoice owned by another tenant therefore receives that invoice instead of the required not-found result.
findings.evidence: requirement.md requires tenant ownership and the same not-found result for foreign invoices; candidate/service.go:7-10 looks up by ID and returns inv without a tenant check.

summary: The candidate compiles, but the change removes the authorization boundary for invoice lookup.

findings.title: destination write errors are discarded
findings.explanation: WriteBatch assigns dst.Put's error to the blank identifier and always returns nil. If any destination write fails, callers are still told the batch export succeeded, violating the failure contract after a partial write.
findings.evidence: requirement.md requires reporting failure for any destination write error; candidate/writer.go:5 discards the error and line 6 unconditionally returns nil.

summary: The candidate compiles, but it masks every destination failure.

findings.title: non-ready statuses are treated as ready
findings.explanation: IsReady returns true for every status except disabled, so pending and failed resources are served. The requirement permits only the exact ready status.
findings.evidence: requirement.md says pending, failed, and disabled resources must remain unavailable; candidate/status.go:3 implements status != "disabled".

summary: The candidate compiles and its visible happy-path test passes, but the readiness predicate admits pending and failed resources.

checks.evidence: ok fixture 0.520s; the only visible test checks ready.

findings.title: the expiry instant is incorrectly accepted
findings.explanation: ValidAt returns true when now equals expires because !now.After(expires) includes equality. The requirement requires validity strictly before expiry, so a request at the exact expiry instant is incorrectly authorized.
findings.evidence: requirement.md requires rejection at the exact timestamp and after it; candidate/link.go:3 uses !now.After(expires), which accepts equality.

summary: The candidate compiles, but the boundary comparison is inclusive instead of strict.
